match.reason: None of the bank points teaches the recruitment process of job ads, applications, interviews and reference checks; they cover identifying staffing needs, why staff matter to objectives, social responsibility toward workers, and leadership styles.

draft.title: Recruiting skilled staff
card: Recruitment is how a business finds and chooses new staff. A business wants people with the skills and attitude the job needs.
The steps usually run in order. The business writes a job ad, people send in applications, and the business picks some applicants to interview.
Last, the business may do reference checks. It phones people who know the applicant's work, such as a past boss, to confirm what the applicant has claimed.
Skilled staff can lift a business's performance. They tend to work faster, make fewer mistakes and serve customers well, which can help sales and profit.
draft.remember: Good recruiting finds skilled staff, and skilled staff can lift how well a business performs.

a.q: Which step in recruiting involves asking a past employer about an applicant's work?
a.why: A reference check means contacting people who know the applicant's work, such as a past boss, to confirm their claims. An interview is tempting, but it is a meeting with the applicant, not a check with someone else.
a.clue: Which step involves speaking to someone other than the applicant?

b.q: Jasmine owns a bike repair shop in Bathurst. She hires a skilled mechanic after checking her references. Why might this help the shop's performance?
opts: Repairs are done faster and with fewer errors
The shop no longer needs to advertise jobs
The shop can ignore what customers want
Wages become lower for all of the staff
b.why: A skilled mechanic can work faster and make fewer mistakes, so customers are served well and sales can grow. Lower wages is tempting, but the card does not say skill cuts wages, and skilled staff are not linked to lower pay.
b.clue: Think about what skilled staff do better at work.

b.best: Repairs are done faster and with fewer errors
